corrections.reason: Post-freeze calculation correction. The Vieta sum is cosθ+tanθ=3, not sinθ+tanθ. With c=cosθ and s=sinθ, c+s/c=3 implies c²+s=3c; the numerator 1+s−s² equals c²+s, and a=1/4 from the root product. Thus the value is (3c)/(c/4)=12, choice ⑤. Original freeze row preserved.

Post-freeze intersection-sum correction. For u=(t−b)/a in (−1,0), the four roots over [0,2π] sum to 5π (whereas for u in (0,1), they sum to 3π); t=b gives 5π, lower endpoint b−a gives 5π/2, upper endpoint b+a gives the minimum 3π/2. Minimum at t=10 requires a+b=10. Conditions are satisfied by b−a=2 and 2<t? specifically t=3 in negative interior when (a,b)=(4,6), so g(2)+g(3)=5π/2+5π=15π/2 and ab=24, choice ⑤. Original freeze row preserved.
